title: Promoting photogenerated charge separation and transfer in a CuBi2O4 photocathode for improved photoelectrochemical performance
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,6235-6246
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01055A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hasmat Khan, Alireza Razazzadeh, Myung-Jin Jung, Qi Zhou, Man Sig Lee, Se-Hun Kwon
A nanostructured CuBi2O4 photocathode by surfactant-assisted sol–gel dropcasting method showed a high photocurrent density of −3.8 mA cm−2 and charge separation efficiency of 30.5% at 0.2 V vs. RHE in 0.1 M Na2SO4 with H2O2 as an electron scavenger.
